definitions.explanation: A ride or entertainment feature at a theme park or amusement park. From English 'attraction'. In Japanese, this word almost exclusively refers to physical rides and attractions at leisure facilities.

examples.japanese: アトラクション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アトラクション⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This amusement park has many popular attractions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧アトラクション⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}→待ち時間：09621_machijikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The wait time for the new attraction was a whole two hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧アトラクション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗|の}れない→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: Small children can't ride attractions that have a height restriction.

notes:
From English 'attraction'. In Japanese, this word is used almost exclusively for rides and entertainment features at theme parks and amusement parks. Unlike in English, it does not typically mean 'appeal' or 'something interesting to see' in a general sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アトラクション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride an attraction
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧アトラクション: popular ride/attraction
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧アトラクション: new attraction
- アトラクション⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}→待ち時間：09621_machijikan⟧: wait time for a ride
- ⟦{絶叫|ぜっきょう}→絶叫：13810_zekkyou⟧アトラクション: thrill ride (lit. 'screaming attraction')

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}→乗り物：01694_norimono⟧: ride — a broader term covering any vehicle or ride, including carnival rides
- ライド: ride — used at some theme parks as a direct loanword from English
